title: Why Do We Exhaust Ourselves With Constant Planning? (1983-01-28)
description:
Are you constantly planning for a future that never satisfies? Discover the spontaneous path to spiritual awakening and how to break free from ego.

This public program explains the difference between mechanical physical practices and true, spontaneous spiritual awakening. Shri Mataji addresses the exhaustion of constant mental planning and the emptiness of material attachments, culminating in a guided experience of self-realization.

Key Topics:
• ☀️ The trap of right-side planning - why overthinking the future exhausts the Pingala Nadi and blocks true spiritual connection
• 🌙 Understanding pure desire (Shuddha Iccha) vs. material desires that never truly satisfy your inner being or bring true peace
• 💭 Why extreme physical yoga without spiritual connection can make you dry, ego-oriented, and completely block your inner growth
• ✨ The beauty of detachment - how to enjoy life's aesthetics and give selflessly without the heavy mental burden of ownership
• ⚡ Guided self-realization experience - awaken your Kundalini naturally and feel the living energy on your own nervous system

“The real Yoga is spontaneous is living process. Is a process which is the Sahaja, Saha means 'with', ja means 'born', is born with you.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• Why do material desires never bring lasting happiness?
• How to stop overthinking and constantly planning the future?
• What is the difference between physical yoga and true awakening?

Have you ever found yourself exhausted by constantly planning the future? Share your experience of finding peace through true meditation!
